blocks.prompt:
1 Describe the development of the structure of benzene from its molecular formula to Kekule's structure. What do X-ray studies show about its shape, bond angles and bond lengths? (4 marks)
(Benzene ke structure ki taraqqi molecular formula se Kekule structure tak bayan karein. X-ray studies is ki shakal, bond angles aur bond lengths ke baare mein kya batati hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Molecular formula: daryaft ke baad benzene ka formula C₆H₆ paaya gaya; yeh sab se saada aromatic hydrocarbon hai.

Linear structures: kuch scientists ne linear structures diye, magar woh benzene ki properties samjha na sake, is liye radd ho gaye.

Kekule structure (1865): German professor August Kekule ne benzene ko chhe members wala cyclic compound bataya jis mein single aur double bonds baari baari hain. Is ne bohat si properties samjhayin magar physical aur chemical properties poori tarah nahi.

X-ray studies:
• Planar molecule, chhe sp² carbons ka regular hexagon.
• Har carbon teen atoms se juda; C–C–C aur H–C–C angles 120°.
• C–H bond length 109 pm (1.090 Å).
• Tamaam C–C bonds barabar, 139 pm (1.3970 Å), jo single bond (154 pm) aur double bond (133 pm) ke darmiyan hai.

Barabar C–C bonds fixed single/double bonds se nahi samjhaye ja sakte; yeh delocalised π electrons se samajh aate hain.

book_ref.quote: X-ray studies of benzene exhibits a planar configuration

blocks.prompt:
2 Explain the thermodynamic stability of benzene on the basis of heats of hydrogenation. Define resonance energy and give its value. (4 marks)
(Heats of hydrogenation ki bunyaad par benzene ki thermodynamic stability samjhayein. Resonance energy ki definition aur qeemat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Benzene mein alkenes ki tarah double bonds hain magar yeh bohat ziyada stable hai. Saboot heats of hydrogenation se milta hai jo stability se mutaliq hain. Neeche ke sab compounds cyclohexane dete hain jo mushtarka low-energy reference point hai.

• Cyclohexene (aik C=C) → cyclohexane: 120 kJ mol⁻¹.
• Cyclohexadiene (do C=C) tawaqqo: 2 × 120 = 240 kJ mol⁻¹.
• Farzi 1,3,5-cyclohexatriene (teen C=C) tawaqqo: 3 × 120 = 360 kJ mol⁻¹.
• Benzene asal: sirf 208 kJ mol⁻¹.

Yani benzene farzi cyclohexatriene se 360 − 208 = 152 kJ mol⁻¹ kam energy par hai; bohat ziyada stable hai.

Resonance energy (delocalisation energy): jitni benzene ki asal heat of hydrogenation theoretical se kam hai; benzene ke liye 152 kJ mol⁻¹. Yeh is liye hai ke π electrons chhe carbons par π overlap se poori ring par phaile hain.

book_ref.quote: Let us analyse the heats of hydrogenation of different cyclohexenes.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: heat jitni kam nikle, compound utna stable. Kitab mein aik jagah 158.5 likha hai jo ghalat chhapa hai; sahih farq 360 − 208 = 152 kJ mol⁻¹ hai.

blocks.prompt:
3 In a series of measurements, a cyclic alkene with one C=C bond releases 119 kJ mol⁻¹ on hydrogenation, and an aromatic ring compound that would have three such C=C bonds in a Kekule-type structure releases 206 kJ mol⁻¹. Calculate (i) the expected heat of hydrogenation of the Kekule-type structure (ii) the resonance energy (iii) the resonance energy as a percentage of the expected value. (4 marks)
(Aik C=C wali cyclic alkene hydrogenation par 119 kJ mol⁻¹ deti hai, aur aik aromatic ring compound jis ke Kekule jaise structure mein teen aise bonds hote, 206 kJ mol⁻¹ deta hai. Nikalein: (i) Kekule jaise structure ki tawaqqo heat (ii) resonance energy (iii) resonance energy tawaqqo qeemat ka kitne feesad hai.)
blocks.explanation: Aik bond ki qeemat ko teen se zarb dein; resonance energy = tawaqqo − asal.

book_ref.quote: It shows benzene is much more stable than the hypothetical cyclohexatriene.

steps: Resonance energy = tawaqqo − asal = 357 − 206 = 151 kJ mol⁻¹
Asal qeemat kam hai, is liye compound Kekule jaise structure se 151 kJ mol⁻¹ ziyada stable hai

blocks.prompt:
4 Explain the atomic orbital structure of benzene. How does it account for equal C–C bond lengths and the usual symbol of benzene? (4 marks)
(Benzene ka atomic orbital structure samjhayein. Yeh barabar C–C bond lengths aur benzene ke aam nishan ki wazahat kaise karta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
σ framework:
• Har carbon sp² hybridized hai.
• Us ke teen sp² orbitals teen σ bonds banate hain: do saath wale carbons se (sp²–sp²) aur aik hydrogen se (sp²–s, H ka 1s orbital).
• Tamaam sp² orbitals aik plane mein, is liye tamaam C aur H atoms 120° par aik plane mein: planar hexagon, 12 σ bonds.

π bonding:
• Har carbon ka aik unhybridized 2p orbital σ framework par amood aur doosron ke parallel hai.
• Chhe 2p orbitals poori ring mein sideways overlap kar ke plane ke upar aur neeche π-electron cloud banate hain; molecule conjugated hai.
• Chhe π electrons chhe carbons mein barabar share: π electrons ki delocalization.

Nataij:
• Tamaam chhe C–C bonds barabar, 139 pm, C–C (154 pm) aur C=C (133 pm) ke darmiyan.
• Benzene hexagon ke andar circle se dikhaya jata hai; circle delocalized π electrons hai.
• Delocalization izafi stability deti hai (resonance energy 152 kJ mol⁻¹).

book_ref.quote: The hexagonal frame work of benzene ring can be conveniently explained by using hybridization approach.

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe the rules for naming monosubstituted and disubstituted benzenes, with examples. What are ortho, meta and para positions? (4 marks)
(Monosubstituted aur disubstituted benzenes ke naam rakhne ke qawaid misaalon ke saath bayan karein. Ortho, meta aur para positions kya hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Monocyclic aromatic hydrocarbons mein aik benzene ring, polycyclic mein do ya ziyada. Benzene derivatives ke naam do tareeqon se: 'benzene' suffix ke saath ya khaas naam se.

Monosubstituted benzenes (aik substituent):
• 'Benzene' base aur substituent prefix: chlorobenzene, nitrobenzene, methyl benzene.
• Bohat se aam naam IUPAC base names hain: phenol (C₆H₅OH), toluene (C₆H₅CH₃), aniline (C₆H₅NH₂); khaas naam jaise benzene carboxylic acid aur benzene sulphonic acid.
• Substituent hamesha C-1 par, is liye number nahi likhte.

Disubstituted benzenes (do substituents):
• Ziyada priority wale substituent ka carbon C₁; baaqi us ke hisaab se. Priority: –COOH > –CN > –CHO > –COCH₃ > –OH > –NH₂ > –OR > –R.
• Barabar priority par alphabet mein pehle wala C₁, maslan 1-bromo-3-chlorobenzene.
• Misaal: –OH aur C₃ par –NH₂: 3-aminophenol.

Ortho, meta, para: do substituents ke liye ortho (o-) = 1,2; meta (m-) = 1,3; para (p-) = 1,4. Maslan 1,4-dibromobenzene = p-dibromobenzene.

book_ref.quote: We will look into nomenclature of monocyclic aromatic compounds first.

blocks.prompt:
6 Compare the reactivity of benzene with that of alkanes and alkenes. Why does benzene undergo electrophilic substitution rather than addition? (4 marks)
(Benzene ki reactivity ka alkanes aur alkenes se muqabla karein. Benzene addition ki jagah electrophilic substitution kyun karta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Alkanes: aam tor par reactive nahi kyun ke non-polar hain aur sirf σ bonds hain; UV light mein free radical substitution aasani se karte hain.

Alkenes: π bond aur electrophiles ke liye maujood π electrons ki wajah se bohat reactive; electrophilic addition aasani se, maslan cyclohexene bina catalyst bromine add karta hai.

Benzene: teen π bonds, alkenes ki tarah electrophiles se react karta hai, magar do farq:
• bohat stable hai, is liye kam reactive (Br₂ ya Cl₂ ke liye Lewis acid chahiye);
• electrophilic substitution karta hai, addition nahi: C₆H₆ + Br₂ → (FeBr₃) C₆H₅Br + HBr.

Wajah: aromatic ring π electrons ki wasee delocalisation se stable hai. Substitution mein intermediate mein aromaticity toot ti hai magar aakhir mein wapas aa jati hai. Addition mein delocalisation khatam ho jati, is liye addition pasandeeda nahi.

book_ref.quote: However, there are two key differences between their reactions with electrophiles:

rows: Br₂ aasani se add, catalyst nahi
Br₂ se sirf Lewis acid ke saath
π bond hamesha ke liye toot ta hai

blocks.prompt:
7 Describe the general mechanism of electrophilic aromatic substitution. (4 marks)
(Electrophilic aromatic substitution ka aam mechanism bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Electrophile jo bhi ho, mechanism ke teen bunyaadi steps hain.

Step 1, electrophile banana: electrophile (E⁺) positive ion ya polar molecule ka positive sira hai. Yeh seedha nahi dala ja sakta, is liye munasib reagents se in situ banaya jata hai, maslan Br₂ + AlBr₃ → Br⁺ + [AlBr₄]⁻.

Step 2, electrophilic hamla: benzene ke π electrons E⁺ par hamla kar ke aik ring carbon aur E mein σ bond banate hain. Yeh carbon sp³ ho jata hai. Aromaticity toot jati hai: sirf chaar π electrons aur positive charge paanch carbons par. Naye σ bond ki wajah se intermediate sigma complex (arenium ion) kehlata hai.
C₆H₆ + E⁺ → [C₆H₆E]⁺

Step 3, aromaticity ki wapsi: counterion/conjugate base sp³ carbon se H ko C–H bond ki heterolytic cleavage se nikalta hai. Electrons π system mein wapas aur delocalisation bahaal.
[C₆H₆E]⁺ → C₆H₅E + H⁺

Kul mila kar ring ka aik hydrogen electrophile se badal jata hai aur stable aromatic ring qaim rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: Regardless of electrophile used, the electrophilic aromatic substitution mechanism can be divided into three main steps.

blocks.prompt:
8 Describe the bromination of benzene in the presence of AlBr₃, giving the mechanism and the role of the Lewis acid. (4 marks)
(AlBr₃ ki maujoodgi mein benzene ki bromination mechanism aur Lewis acid ke kirdar ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Benzene bromine se sirf Lewis acid (AlCl₃, FeCl₃ ya FeBr₃, yahan AlBr₃) ki maujoodgi mein react karta hai jo halogen se jud kar taqatwar electrophile banata hai.
Kul: C₆H₆ + Br₂ → (AlBr₃) C₆H₅Br + HBr

Mechanism:
1. Electrophile banna: AlBr₃ Br₂ ko polarise (Brδ+–Brδ−) kar ke Br⁻ le leta hai:
Br₂ + AlBr₃ → Br⁺ + [AlBr₄]⁻
2. Br⁺ par hamla: ring ke π electrons Br⁺ par hamla kar ke sigma complex [C₆H₆Br]⁺ banate hain; aromaticity waqti tor par khatam.
3. Proton ka nikalna: [AlBr₄]⁻ sp³ carbon se H⁺ nikalta hai; aromaticity wapas aur catalyst dobara:
[C₆H₆Br]⁺ + [AlBr₄]⁻ → C₆H₅Br + HBr + AlBr₃

Lewis acid ka kirdar: Br⁺ banata hai aur aakhir mein wapas mil jata hai, is liye catalyst hai. Isi tarah FeCl₃ chlorination ke liye Cl⁺ banata hai, mechanism wohi hai.

book_ref.quote: This is bromination of benzene, which involves following steps:

blocks.prompt:
9 Describe the nitration of benzene, giving the reagents, conditions, mechanism and the effect of temperature. (4 marks)
(Benzene ki nitration reagents, shiraait, mechanism aur temperature ke asar ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Nitration mein conc. HNO₃ aur conc. H₂SO₄ ke mixture se benzene par nitro group lagaya jata hai.
C₆H₆ + HNO₃ → (conc. H₂SO₄) C₆H₅NO₂ + H₂O

Mechanism:
1. Electrophile banana: conc. HNO₃ aur conc. H₂SO₄ ke reaction se NO₂⁺ ion banta hai.
2. Electrophilic hamla: benzene ring ka electron pair NO₂⁺ ko diya jata hai, covalent bond aur sigma complex banta hai; aromaticity khatam.
3. Aromaticity ki wapsi: substituted carbon ka C–H bond toot ta hai aur electrons π system mein wapas, nitrobenzene banta hai.

H₂SO₄ ka kirdar: catalyst hai, is liye equation mein nahi likha jata.

Temperature ka asar: ziyada temperature par aik se ziyada nitro groups lagne ka imkaan barhta hai. 50 °C par bhi kuch 1,3-dinitrobenzene banta hai kyun ke –NO₂ meta director hai.

book_ref.quote: The mechanism involves the following steps:

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe Friedel-Crafts alkylation of benzene with its three-step mechanism, taking chloroethane as the alkyl halide. (4 marks)
(Chloroethane ko alkyl halide le kar benzene ki Friedel-Crafts alkylation teen steps ke mechanism ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Friedel-Crafts alkylation mein Lewis acid AlCl₃ ki maujoodgi mein benzene ring mein alkyl group lagaya jata hai.
Kul: C₆H₆ + CH₃CH₂Cl → (AlCl₃) C₆H₅CH₂CH₃ + HCl

Step 1, carbocation banna: AlCl₃ alkyl halide se react kar ke carbocation banata hai jo electrophile hai:
CH₃CH₂Cl + AlCl₃ → CH₃CH₂⁺ + AlCl₄⁻

Step 2, carbocation par hamla: ring ke π electrons carbocation par hamla kar ke arenium ion banate hain; aromaticity waqti tor par khatam:
C₆H₆ + CH₃CH₂⁺ → [C₆H₆CH₂CH₃]⁺

Step 3, proton nikalna: H⁺ nikalne se aromaticity wapas. Proton HCl banata hai aur AlCl₃ wapas milta hai:
[C₆H₆CH₂CH₃]⁺ + AlCl₄⁻ → C₆H₅CH₂CH₃ + HCl + AlCl₃

AlCl₃ wapas milta hai is liye catalyst hai; product ethylbenzene (alkylbenzene) hai.

book_ref.quote: The Lewis acid catalyst (AlCl₃) undergoes reaction with the alkyl halide

blocks.prompt:
11 What is an acyl group? Describe Friedel-Crafts acylation of benzene with its mechanism, taking propanoyl chloride, CH₃CH₂COCl, as the acyl halide. (4 marks)
(Acyl group kya hai? Propanoyl chloride, CH₃CH₂COCl, ko acyl halide le kar benzene ki Friedel-Crafts acylation mechanism ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Acyl group carbonyl group se juda alkyl group hai, R–C=O. Friedel-Crafts acylation mein Lewis acid AlCl₃ ki maujoodgi mein benzene ring mein acyl group lagaya jata hai.
Kul: C₆H₆ + CH₃CH₂COCl → (AlCl₃) C₆H₅COCH₂CH₃ + HCl

Mechanism:
1. Acylium ion banna: AlCl₃ acyl halide se complex banata hai jo halide ion kho deta hai:
CH₃CH₂COCl + AlCl₃ → CH₃CH₂CO⁺ + AlCl₄⁻
2. Electrophilic hamla: ring ke π electrons acylium ion (RCO⁺) par hamla kar ke intermediate complex (sigma complex) banate hain.
3. Proton nikalna: intermediate H⁺ kho kar aromaticity wapas laata hai.
4. Proton chloride ion se mil kar HCl banata hai aur AlCl₃ wapas milta hai:
H⁺ + AlCl₄⁻ → HCl + AlCl₃

Product acyl benzene, C₆H₅COCH₂CH₃, hai.

book_ref.quote: A reaction occurs between the Lewis acid catalyst (AlCl₃) and the acyl halide.

blocks.prompt:
12 Explain how the electrophile is generated in (i) bromination (ii) nitration (iii) Friedel-Crafts alkylation (iv) Friedel-Crafts acylation of benzene. Name the electrophile and the product in each case. (4 marks)
(Benzene ki (i) bromination (ii) nitration (iii) Friedel-Crafts alkylation (iv) Friedel-Crafts acylation mein electrophile kaise banta hai? Har case mein electrophile aur product ka naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Har electrophilic substitution ka pehla step munasib reagents se in situ electrophile banana hai; baaqi mechanism (hamla, sigma complex, H⁺ nikalna) aik jaisa hai.

(i) Bromination: Br₂ aur Lewis acid (AlBr₃/FeBr₃): Br₂ + AlBr₃ → Br⁺ + [AlBr₄]⁻. Electrophile Br⁺; product bromobenzene, C₆H₅Br.
(ii) Nitration: conc. HNO₃ aur conc. H₂SO₄ se NO₂⁺. Electrophile NO₂⁺; product nitrobenzene, C₆H₅NO₂.
(iii) Alkylation: alkyl halide aur AlCl₃: RCl + AlCl₃ → R⁺ + AlCl₄⁻. Electrophile carbocation R⁺; product alkylbenzene, C₆H₅R.
(iv) Acylation: acyl halide aur AlCl₃: RCOCl + AlCl₃ → RCO⁺ + AlCl₄⁻. Electrophile acylium ion RCO⁺; product acyl benzene, C₆H₅COR.

Har case mein catalyst (Lewis acid ya H₂SO₄) wapas mil jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Generation of electrophile: The first step of an electrophilic substitution reaction involves the generation of an electrophile.

blocks.prompt:
13 What are meta-directing groups? Explain their effect on the reactivity of the ring and on orientation, with examples and the chlorination of nitrobenzene. (4 marks)
(Meta-directing groups kya hain? Ring ki reactivity aur orientation par in ka asar misaalon aur nitrobenzene ki chlorination ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ring par laga har group aage ki electrophilic substitution par asar dalta hai aur aane wale electrophile ki orientation tay karta hai.

Meta-directing (deactivating) groups:
• Jo group ring ko benzene se kam reactive kare aur electrophile ko meta par bheje, meta director hai.
• Yeh zyada tar electron-withdrawing hain; arenium (sigma complex) intermediate ko destabilize karte hain.
• Zyada tar meta (1,3) product dete hain.
• Misaalein: –CN, C=O, –NO₂, –CO₂–.

Misaal, nitrobenzene ki chlorination: –NO₂ meta director hai, is liye chlorination meta par hoti hai aur bara product 1-chloro-3-nitrobenzene hai:
C₆H₅NO₂ + Cl₂ → (FeCl₃) m-ClC₆H₄NO₂ + HCl

Isi tarah nitrobenzene ki mazeed nitration se 1,3-dinitrobenzene banta hai.

book_ref.quote: These substituents direct the reaction to give primarily the

blocks.prompt:
14 What are ortho-para directing groups? Explain with examples, and describe the ring chlorination of methylbenzene with conditions and a balanced equation. (4 marks)
(Ortho-para directing groups kya hain? Misaalon se samjhayein aur methylbenzene ki ring chlorination shiraait aur balanced equation ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ortho-para directing (activating) groups:
• Jo group ring ko benzene se ziyada reactive kare aur electrophile ko ortho aur para par bheje, ortho-para director hai.
• Ortho (1,2) ya para (1,4) product deta hai, para ko thori tarjeeh; meta product bohat hi kam.
• Yeh groups ring ko electrons de sakte hain.
• Misaalein: –SR, –R, –OH, –OR, –NR₂, –SH.

Methylbenzene ki chlorination:
• Shiraait: AlCl₃ (bromine ke saath AlBr₃) ya iron, UV light nahi, room temperature.
• Methyl group 2,4-directing hai, is liye 2-chloromethylbenzene aur 4-chloromethylbenzene ka mixture:
2C₆H₅CH₃ + 2Cl₂ → 2-ClC₆H₄CH₃ + 4-ClC₆H₄CH₃ + 2HCl
• Bromine se usi tarah ke bromine compounds.

CH₃ ki tarah OH bhi ring activator hai; phenol mein aane wale groups 2, 4 aur 6 positions par jate hain.

book_ref.quote: The chlorination in the methyl benzene ring takes place in the presence of aluminium chloride

blocks.prompt:
15 15.6 g of benzene is burnt completely in excess air according to 2C₆H₆ + 15O₂ → 12CO₂ + 6H₂O. Taking C₆H₆ = 78, O₂ = 32, CO₂ = 44 and H₂O = 18 g mol⁻¹, calculate (i) the mass of oxygen used (ii) the masses of CO₂ and H₂O formed, and show that mass is conserved. (4 marks)
(15.6 g benzene ziyada hawa mein 2C₆H₆ + 15O₂ → 12CO₂ + 6H₂O ke mutabiq mukammal jalaya jata hai. C₆H₆ = 78, O₂ = 32, CO₂ = 44 aur H₂O = 18 g mol⁻¹ le kar nikalein: (i) istemal hui oxygen ki mass (ii) bane CO₂ aur H₂O ki masses, aur dikhayein ke mass mehfooz rehti hai.)
blocks.explanation: Benzene ko moles mein badlein, phir balanced equation ki ratio 2 : 15 : 12 : 6 istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: When benzene is burnt in excess of air

steps: Reactants: 15.6 + 48.0 = 63.6 g; products: 52.8 + 10.8 = 63.6 g, yani mass mehfooz hai
blocks.final_answer: (i) 48.0 g O₂ (ii) 52.8 g CO₂ aur 10.8 g H₂O; dono taraf kul 63.6 g

blocks.prompt:
16 What is side-chain oxidation of alkylbenzenes? Give the reagents, the condition needed, examples, and its use as an identification test. (4 marks)
(Alkylbenzenes ki side-chain oxidation kya hai? Reagents, zaroori shart, misaalein aur pehchan ke test ke tor par is ka istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: benzene ring se seedha jude alkyl group par hone wali oxidation side-chain oxidation hai.

Reagents: alkaline KMnO₄, acidic K₂Cr₂O₇ ya dilute HNO₃.

Product: alkyl group, size jo bhi ho, carboxylic acid group ban jata hai aur ring qaim rehti hai. Alkyl group jitna bhi lamba ho, har side chain se sirf aik –COOH.
• Methylbenzene (toluene) → benzoic acid, C₆H₅COOH.
• Ethylbenzene → benzoic acid.
• 1, 3, 5 par teen alkyl groups wala arene, har aik par benzylic H → benzene-1,3,5-tricarboxylic acid.

Shart: ring ke saath wale carbon par kam az kam aik benzylic hydrogen zaroori. Benzylic H na ho (ring se juda tertiary carbon, maslan tert-butylbenzene) to reaction nahi.

Wajah: alkanes aur benzene alag alag oxidation se mehfooz hain, magar mil kar benzylic carbon ziyada reactive ho jata hai.

Pehchan ka test: benzylic H wale alkylbenzene ko oxidize karte waqt KMnO₄ ka purple rang khatam ho jata hai. Benzene aur tertiary alkyl wale alkylbenzenes ke saath rang rehta hai; primary ya secondary alkyl wale rang khatam karte hain (test primary aur secondary mein farq nahi karta).

book_ref.quote: Following example demonstrates the utilization of oxidation reaction in the production of substituted benzoic acid.

blocks.prompt:
17 Describe the addition reactions of benzene: hydrogenation and addition of halogens. Why do these reactions need special conditions? (4 marks)
(Benzene ke addition reactions bayan karein: hydrogenation aur halogens ka addition. In reactions ko khaas shiraait kyun chahiye?)
blocks.explanation:
(a) Hydrogenation: benzene ke carbons par 1, 2 ya 3 mol H₂ add hote hain. Mukammal hydrogenation se cyclohexane banta hai jo faida-mand solvent aur doosre chemicals ka precursor hai:
C₆H₆ + 3H₂ → (Ni, taqreeban 150 °C, ziyada pressure) C₆H₁₂
Isi tarah methylbenzene se methylcyclohexane: C₆H₅CH₃ + 3H₂ → C₆H₁₁CH₃.
Shiraait: alkenes wala hi bareek nickel catalyst aur taqreeban wohi temperature (150 °C), magar ziyada pressure.

(b) Halogens ka addition: chlorine aur bromine aik hi tarah react karte hain. Catalyst ke baghair UV light aur heat mukammal halogenation ke liye kaafi hain:
C₆H₆ + 3Cl₂ → (UV light, heat) C₆H₆Cl₆

Khaas shiraait kyun: yeh reactions ring ki delocalisation khatam karte hain kyun ke π electrons naye atoms se bond banate hain. Mazboot naye C–H bonds ki wajah se reaction exothermic hai magar activation barrier ooncha hai, is liye ziyada pressure (hydrogenation) ya UV light aur heat (halogenation) chahiye.

book_ref.quote: We will examine hydrogenation and halogenation addition reactions of benzene in the following reactions.

blocks.prompt:
18 31.2 g of benzene is completely hydrogenated to cyclohexane over a nickel catalyst. Taking C₆H₆ = 78, H₂ = 2 and C₆H₁₂ = 84 g mol⁻¹ and the heat of hydrogenation of benzene from the chapter (208 kJ mol⁻¹ released), calculate (i) the mass of hydrogen needed (ii) the mass of cyclohexane formed (iii) the heat released. (4 marks)
(31.2 g benzene nickel catalyst par mukammal cyclohexane mein badla jata hai. C₆H₆ = 78, H₂ = 2 aur C₆H₁₂ = 84 g mol⁻¹ aur chapter ki benzene ki heat of hydrogenation (208 kJ mol⁻¹ kharij) le kar nikalein: (i) zaroori hydrogen ki mass (ii) bane cyclohexane ki mass (iii) kharij hone wali heat.)
blocks.explanation: Benzene ke moles nikalein; masses ke liye C₆H₆ + 3H₂ → C₆H₁₂ aur heat ke liye har mol benzene par 208 kJ.

book_ref.quote: Cyclohexane is produced when benzene is completely hydrogenated.

steps: C₆H₆ + 3H₂ → C₆H₁₂: H₂ = 3 × 0.400 = 1.20 mol; mass = 1.20 × 2 = 2.40 g
blocks.final_answer: (i) 2.40 g H₂ (ii) 33.6 g cyclohexane (iii) 83.2 kJ kharij

blocks.prompt:
19 Benzene reacts with chlorine in two different ways depending on the conditions. Describe (i) the reaction in the presence of FeCl₃ (ii) the reaction in UV light and heat without a catalyst. Explain why the two products differ. (4 marks)
(Benzene shiraait ke mutabiq chlorine se do tarah react karta hai. Bayan karein: (i) FeCl₃ ki maujoodgi mein reaction (ii) catalyst ke baghair UV light aur heat mein reaction. Dono products mukhtalif kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) FeCl₃ (Lewis acid) ke saath: electrophilic substitution. FeCl₃ Cl⁺ banata hai jo π electrons par hamla kar ke sigma complex banata hai; H⁺ nikalne se aromaticity wapas.
C₆H₆ + Cl₂ → (FeCl₃) C₆H₅Cl + HCl
Aik Cl aik H ki jagah leta hai aur aromatic ring qaim rehti hai.

(ii) UV light aur heat, catalyst nahi: addition. UV light aur heat mukammal halogenation ke liye kaafi hain; teen Cl₂ molecules ring par add hote hain.
C₆H₆ + 3Cl₂ → (UV light, heat) C₆H₆Cl₆
Delocalisation khatam ho jati hai kyun ke π electrons naye chlorine atoms se bond banate hain.

Farq kyun: Lewis acid se taqatwar electrophile banta hai aur stable aromatic ring aakhir mein wapas aa jati hai, is liye substitution hoti hai. UV light aur heat ki sakht shiraait addition ki oonchi rukawat paar kar leti hain aur ring ki delocalisation khatam ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Chlorine and bromine react in the same way.
